tex_content.html:
Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0060 1. Lemma 2.31\group neckpinch

The slope $v=\psi _s$ has finitely many zeroes, the number of zeroes is nonincreasing in time, and the number drops if a degenerate critical point appears.
